name: Dick's Long Hard Night
source:
Crime in Gotham City is a disease. A disease that can only be wiped away by one man. 

Dick Grayson. The Nightwing. 

Play through the night as Dick traces a mysterious piece of tech across the city, sniffing out injustice and running into a few beautiful damsels as well. Your choices in dialogue will influence the outcome of this dastardly plot! 

[From [url=https://shagamon.itch.io/dicks-night]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
哥谭市的犯罪是一种疾病。一种只能靠一个人就能消灭的疾病。

迪克·格雷森.夜翼。

通宵畅玩，迪克在城市中追踪一项神秘科技，嗅出不公正现象，并遇到了一些美丽的少女。你在对话中的选择将影响这个卑鄙阴谋的结果！

[来自[url=https://shagamon.itch.io/dicks-night]itch.io[/url]]
